claims.claim_vi: When the user clicks Buy, a payment event is generated and sent to the payment service, which stores it in the database.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: A single payment event may contain several payment orders (for example products from several sellers in one checkout); the payment service calls the payment executor for each payment order, and the payment executor stores the order in the database.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: The payment executor calls an external PSP to finish the credit card payment.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: After the payment executor has executed the payment successfully, the payment service updates the wallet with how much money a seller has; the wallet server stores the balance in the database.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: After the wallet is updated, the payment service calls the ledger, which appends the new ledger information to the database.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Every night the PSP or banks send settlement files to their clients; a settlement file holds the balance of the bank account and all the transactions on it during the day.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: The reading of "append" as "never rewritten" and the pairing of the settlement file with reconciliation are the author's reasoning from the source.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge; not checked against payment-industry documentation.

design_notes_vi: Hai lược đồ ba bên cho hai chặng của luồng (gọi PSP, rồi ghi sổ), rồi một khung ghi ba điều cần nhớ. Hai bên đầu của lược đồ hai lặp lại dịch vụ thanh toán để người đọc thấy nó điều phối cả hai chặng.
source_deviations: The source lists the flow as ten bullets; the lesson draws the executor-to-PSP and wallet-ledger parts as two sequences and keeps the database writes as a note, not as extra actors.

The source does not say the PSP answers the executor; the lesson draws a reply because the next step starts "after the payment executor has successfully executed the payment", and marks the message as the success result.
The source says the nightly settlement file is sent to clients; the lesson links it to reconciliation as the author's reasoning, not as a source claim.
